title: Hearty Norwegian Salmon Fried-Rice
description: A savory, charred salmon fried rice topped with creamy fromage frais and crunchy peanuts, bringing a burst of Norwegian flavor to the table.
instructions: Heat 0.5 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon fillet, searing each side for 2 minutes until a charred crust forms, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, scramble the eggs until just set, then remove and keep warm.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, stirring to coat with oil and break up clumps.
Pour in soy sauce and season with black pepper, tossing to combine.
Return the salmon and eggs to the skillet, folding them into the rice.
Stir in fresh spinach until wilted, then mix in toasted peanuts for crunch.
Top the fried rice with a generous spoonful of fromage frais and sprinkle red chili flakes if desired.
Serve immediately, letting the fromage frais melt slightly over the hot rice.
